app.name: Explainable AI Lab
app.tagline: Teach a computer to see — then find out how it decided.

action.copyFailed: Copy did not work — select the text and copy it by hand.

backend.unaccelerated: Graphics acceleration is not available on this device, so training and explanations will be slower. Everything still works.
backend.checking: Checking what this device can do…

storage.label: Space used on this device
storage.unknown: This browser will not say how much space is left. Keep an eye on how many projects you hold.
storage.warn: You have used {{percent}}% of the space this browser gives the lab. Delete a project you have finished with to make room.
storage.refuse: There is not enough space left to capture more. Delete a project you have finished with, then try again.
storage.persistRequested: Asked the browser to keep your work rather than clearing it automatically.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.generic: That did not work. Nothing was lost — try again.
error.offline: You are offline. Projects already on this device still work; anything that needs the network will wait.
error.notFoundBody: Check the address, or go back to your projects.
error.forbidden: This part of the lab is not for your account.
error.forbiddenForRole: Your account does not have access to this part of the lab. That is deliberate rather than a mistake.
error.forbiddenSignIn: This part of the lab needs an account. Ask your educator for a username and a code.

privacy.onDevice: Your photos, your trained model and your heat maps stay on this device. They are never uploaded.
